key.name: monochrome-icon
key.description: System tray icon should be monochrome or not

key.name: autostart
key.description: Deprecated: value is migrated to startup-behavior and reset on first run

key.name: startup-behavior
key.description: Whether the overlay is off, on, or restored to its last state when the extension starts

key.name: last-state
key.description: Internal: whether the overlay was on when last toggled

key.name: cap-alpha
key.description: Whether to cap the alpha/opacity at 240 out of 250 to prevent the overlay becoming opaque

key.name: overlay-color
key.description: The value of the stored color as a Clutter.Color string
